items.title: We're releasing the weights of Mistral Large 4
items.summary: The weights of Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk) are now open. A 1T parameter multimodal model, and best open-weight model for coding, trained in Europe.
items.titleZh: 我们将开放 Mistral Large 4 的模型权重
items.summaryZh: Mistral Large 4（Le Chonk）的模型权重现已开放。这是一款拥有 1 万亿参数的多模态模型，也是最出色的开放权重编程模型，在欧洲训练。

items.title: DoorDash to acquire Instacart
items.summary: Together, DoorDash and Instacart would help stores of every size reach more customers with the kinds of innovative technology that the biggest online retailers and grocers build for themselves.
items.summaryZh: DoorDash 与 Instacart 联手后，将帮助各种规模的商家触达更多顾客，并提供大型线上零售商和杂货商自行开发的那类创新技术。

items.title: LLM Voice
items.summary: Sometimes when I read a post, I get the growing feeling that I'm reading the output of an LLM. I can't necessarily define why, although there are the common tells (it's not the em-dashes, it's the load-bearing tapestries…
items.summaryZh: 有时读一篇文章时，我会越来越觉得自己读到的是大语言模型的输出。我未必能说清原因，尽管确实有一些常见迹象（问题不在破折号，而在那些承重的挂毯……）。

items.title: H.264 Is Magic (2016)

items.summaryZh: 通俗介绍 MPEG、AVC/H.264 编解码器所用视频压缩技术的基础知识。

items.title: A tiny world model running games on a Raspberry Pi Pico 2 W
items.summary: Tiny world model generates games and stream ac plays them all on Pico 2W - SheepSeb/tinyworldformer

items.title: You don’t need to believe in a god to get a religious exemption from using AI at work
items.summary: David Durman, a University of Kentucky administrator, recently earned a religious exemption from using AI in the workplace.
items.titleZh: 申请工作中不使用 AI 的宗教豁免，不必信仰上帝
items.summaryZh: 肯塔基大学行政人员 David Durman 最近获得了在工作场所不使用 AI 的宗教豁免。

items.title: AWS will be a $1T business, Jassy says. But first, it will spend big.
items.summary: Amazon wants to be the king of AI cloud computing and become the first $1 trillion revenue business. But to do that it will have to continue on its capex spending spree, its CEO said Thursday.
items.titleZh: Jassy 称 AWS 将成为万亿美元级业务，但首先要大举投入
items.summaryZh: 亚马逊希望成为 AI 云计算领域的领头羊，并成为首家营收达 1 万亿美元的企业。但亚马逊首席执行官周四表示，要实现这一目标，公司还得继续大举增加资本支出。

items.title: As search traffic dries up, Reddit announces it’s shifting to a logged-in experience
items.summary: As AI transforms how people find information online, Reddit is rethinking its open-web roots to protect its audience and business.
items.titleZh: 随着搜索流量减少，Reddit 宣布转向登录后使用模式
items.summaryZh: 随着 AI 改变人们在线查找信息的方式，Reddit 正重新审视其开放网络起源，以保护用户群体和业务。

items.title: Rivian expands joint venture with VW to include AI assistant
items.summary: Rivian doesn't disclose if the value of its $5.8 billion joint venture will expand as a result.
items.titleZh: Rivian 扩大与大众汽车的合资项目，加入 AI 助手
items.summaryZh: Rivian 未透露其价值 58 亿美元的合资项目是否会因此扩大规模。

items.title: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings acquires ADT
items.summary: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings is buying ADT in a $15.3 billion deal, with plans to bring AI to the home security business.
items.titleZh: 获 OpenAI 支持的 Thrive Holdings 收购 ADT
items.summaryZh: 获 OpenAI 支持的 Thrive Holdings 将以 153 亿美元收购 ADT，并计划将 AI 引入家庭安防业务。

items.title: Andy Jassy says Prime Video is on track to earn ‘tens of billions of dollars’
items.summary: The success of blockbuster hits like Project Hail Mary and Verity is only part of the story, Amazon's CEO says.
items.titleZh: Andy Jassy 称 Prime Video 有望创造“数百亿美元”收入
items.summaryZh: 亚马逊首席执行官表示，《挽救计划》和《Verity》等大片的成功只是故事的一部分。

items.title: Binance pauses withdrawals as hackers suspected of stealing billions in crypto
items.summary: Some estimates say hackers stole billions in crypto from Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange, during a cyberattack on Thursday.
items.titleZh: 黑客疑似窃取数十亿美元加密货币，Binance 暂停提现
items.summaryZh: 据部分估算，黑客在周四的一次网络攻击中从全球最大的加密货币交易所 Binance 窃取了数十亿美元的加密货币。

items.title: Elon Musk is ‘truly a genius,’ says Vladimir Putin
items.summary: Putin said that he and Musk are in "close contact" about Rassvet, Russia's Starlink-like satellite connectivity project.
items.titleZh: 普京称埃隆·马斯克“确实是天才”
items.summaryZh: 普京称，他与马斯克就俄罗斯类似 Starlink 的卫星连接项目 Rassvet 保持“密切联系”。
